assumptions: No elevation/section supplied: z_floor=0, ceiling 3.0m, door height 2.1m, window sill 0.9m and head 2.4m are EXPLICIT ASSUMPTIONS, not observations.
Exterior wall thickness taken as the annotated 240mm; the drawn grey band is ~11px (~300mm) including finish; openings are placed on the outer-face plane.

Interior partitions drawn as thin double lines; nominal 120mm assumed for thickness reporting only (BIM paths are midplanes; single-mask-row walls resolved to line-pair centres via zooms where visible).
Room roles inferred from furniture symbols (desks, meeting tables, conference oval, lounge counter, workroom bench), not from labels.
Door operating states unknown; swing directions read from leaf+arc symbols.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.
